set.body: At the pinned eyesim revision, cover scanpath, scanpath_similarity, multi_match, fixation_similarity and fixation_overlap. Enumerate MultiMatch components and window behavior, Sinkhorn normalization, overlap distance metric, threshold, 20-unit time sampling and unsupported cases. Reconcile the existing Python MultiMatch conformance separately from eyesim. Exit with pinned R fixtures, small analytic cases, portable tests and explicit method availability.
set.title: Pin basic scanpath and fixation-pattern conformance
